The Alive Private Luxury Detox For Body Mind and Life. How It Works & Who It Is For?
May 8
9 min read

Alive Luxury Retreats has been delivering private luxury detox retreats for high performing individuals, executives and HNWI since 2009. This is not just a cleanse. It is a complete physical, mental and life reset delivered by a world class team working exclusively around one client at a time.
You already know something has to change.

Not because you are in crisis though it might be a slippery slope. Not because everything has fallen apart completely. But because the way you have been living has quietly caught up with you and your body is making that very clear.
Over the years your body has kept the score. Your habits are showing you what is quietly sitting underneath and you are ready for a full reset.
The energy is not what it was.
The weight has crept on.
The habits that used to be occasional have become constant.
The alcohol that took the edge off has become the thing you rely on.
The sleep is broken.
The skin is tired. And those health issues are increasing and getting to the point where you cannot ignore it anymore.
And somewhere underneath the performance and the pace, you know you are running on the wrong fuel.
You are not looking for a temporary fix.
You are looking for a real reset.
One that cleans up the body properly, breaks the habits for good and leaves you feeling like the version of yourself you know is in there.
This is what the Alive private luxury detox retreat actually delivers.
Who Is a Private Luxury Detox Retreat Actually For?
You are high functioning. You are self aware. And you know exactly how you got here. You are just done trying to make the changes alone.
Years of operating at full pace with the lifestyle that comes with it.
Client dinners and late nights.
Constant travel and disrupted sleep.
Stress managed with alcohol.
Anxiety managed with substances.
Habits that started as occasional and became constant.
A body that has been pushed hard and fuelled with the wrong things for too long.
You might be carrying weight you cannot shift no matter what you try.
You might be drinking more than you are comfortable with.
Smoking or vaping in ways that embarrass you given everything else you have built. Relying on prescription medications in ways you want to change.
Dabbling in substances that have become more frequent than occasional.
You are not in clinical crisis. You do not need emergency medical intervention.
You are ready to stop. To clean up.
To do it properly, privately and once.
And to make changes that actually last.
And you want more than just a detox.
You want to deal with the stress that drove the habits.
You want to lose the weight.
You want to value the body you live in.
You want to rebuild your health from the inside out.
You want to come out the other side with a completely different relationship with how you live.
You want to detox your mind and your life as much as you need to do a full body detox.
At Alive the two are never separated.
That is exactly what Alive is built for.
Why Most Detox Programs Do Not Create Lasting Change
Most detox programs address the body alone.
They remove the toxins. They restrict the diet. They clean the gut for a week or two. And for a short time you genuinely feel better.
Then you go home. And the same stress is waiting...
...the same triggers are there.
...the same lifestyle, the same habits of mind and the same environment that created the problem in the first place.
Within weeks or months you are back where you started.
Because detox without addressing everything that drove the toxic overload is not a solution. It is a pause.
Real and lasting change requires going all the way to the root...
...to the physical body and what it is actually carrying.
...to the habits and patterns that have become wired in.
...to the stress and burnout driving the coping mechanisms.
...to the emotional landscape underneath it all.
...and to the life structure that will either support or undermine everything you rebuild.
This is the difference between a standard detox and spa program, a rehab with many others and the Alive private luxury detox retreat.
What the Alive Detox Program Is and What It Is Not
It is important to be clear about what Alive offers.
We do not offer clinical medical detox for severe dependency or conditions that require round the clock medical, psychiatric and restrictive supervision.
This is a specialist area and there are dedicated clinical facilities that serve that need well. We are not a clinical facility.
You MUST want to be here. You must be ready for change. And most importantly this is your choice.
What we offer is something entirely different.

A world class biomedical detox program delivered privately, in a five star luxury environment, by a dedicated expert team working exclusively around you. For those who are ready to stop, who do not require clinical medical intervention and who want to detox deeply and permanently as part of a complete life reset.
If you are unsure whether your situation falls within what we offer, one honest conversation will tell us both. We only work with clients we are confident we can genuinely help.
What Does the Alive Private Detox Program Actually Include For The Physical Full Body Cleanse?
Your dedicated medical and holistic health team begins with a complete biomedical assessment.

Live blood analysis that shows in real time exactly what is happening in your blood and what your body is carrying. Advanced diagnostics and comprehensive blood panels that identify the specific imbalances, deficiencies and toxic loads your system is dealing with. A full health history and lifestyle assessment that builds the complete picture before a single protocol begins.
From there your bespoke detox program is built precisely around what your body actually needs.
IV Therapy and Ozone Therapy

Targeted vitamins, minerals, antioxidants and cellular oxygen support delivered directly into the bloodstream. Bypassing the digestive system entirely and creating immediate restoration at a cellular level.
Gut Restoration and Microbiome Healing

Addressing the damage that alcohol, poor diet, stress, medications and substances cause to the gut lining and the microbiome. Food as medicine, targeted supplementation and advanced gut healing protocols that rebuild the foundation everything else depends on.
Liver and Organ Support
Assisting the body's own detoxification pathways to clear the accumulated toxic load safely and effectively. Without the harsh symptoms that poorly designed detox programs so often create.
Lymphatic Drainage and Body Treatments
Supporting the physical removal of toxins through the lymphatic system. Reducing inflammation and accelerating the restoration process in ways that can be felt immediately.
Personalised Detox Nutrition
Designed by your dedicated nutritionist around your specific health picture and your body's needs. Extraordinary food that heals, nourishes and satisfies. Never deprivation.
Hormonal and Adrenal Support

Addressing the significant impact that long term stress, alcohol, substances and poor lifestyle have on the hormonal system and adrenal glands. Restoring the balance that affects energy, mood, weight and sleep.
Sleep Restoration
Rebuilding the sleep architecture that alcohol, substances and chronic stress systematically dismantle. Most clients sleep more deeply within the first few days than they have in years.
Weight Loss and Body Composition Support

blocks.alt: best wellness retreats in the world

blocks.text: Through the combination of nutrition, movement, metabolic support and the removal of the underlying drivers of weight gain including inflammation, hormonal imbalance and gut dysfunction.

The physical results are fast and they are real. Most clients feel a significant shift within the first few days. By the end of their stay the body has genuinely transformed at a level that months of conventional approaches have failed to reach.
The Full Reset — Beyond the Physical Detox
The physical detox is the foundation. But it is only the beginning.

Because the habits, the lifestyle and the coping mechanisms that drove the toxic overload do not live in the body alone. They live in the stress patterns, the emotional landscape, the identity and the way life has been structured.
Unless all of that changes too, the body you detox will simply fill up again.
So alongside the biomedical detox your program includes the full depth of what Alive delivers.
Deep Relaxation and Nervous System Restoration

Daily spa therapies, healing bodywork, massage, sound healing on the beach and deeply restorative treatments. Your body releases what it has been holding. Your nervous system genuinely settles. Perhaps for the first time in years.
Movement, Vitality and Physical Reconnection

Private yoga, personalised fitness, ocean swimming, nature walks and adventure experiences in the extraordinary landscapes of Bali or Mexico. Not as exercise. As the process of reconnecting to a body that feels strong, light and fully alive again.
Stress and Burnout Recovery

Because behind almost every lifestyle that requires a detox is a level of stress and pressure that was never properly addressed. Your program works through this directly using the same advanced approach we bring to our private burnout retreat clients.
Emotional Healing and Deep Release

One to one therapeutic and healing work that addresses what has been driving the coping mechanisms. The emotional patterns, the pressure, the anxiety and the weight of years of holding everything together that no amount of physical detox can touch on its own.
Habit and Pattern Transformation

Through the Alive coaching process you understand exactly what has been driving the habits, why they served a purpose and how to replace them permanently with ways of living that support rather than deplete you.
Life Redesign and Direction

Because detox clients almost always arrive wanting more than a cleaner body. They want a different life. One that does not require the substances and coping mechanisms that brought them here. Your coaching and life direction work builds exactly that.
Cultural Immersion and Beauty

blocks.alt: luxury private 5 star beachfront villas and residences at alive retrea

blocks.text: The extraordinary environments of Bali and Mexico are woven into every day. The ocean, the temples, the landscapes, the food, the culture. These are not extras. They are part of what reconnects you to a sense of wonder, presence and joy that the lifestyle you are leaving behind had quietly taken away.
You do not leave the Alive detox retreat simply cleaner.
You leave lighter, healthier, calmer and completely different in how you relate to your body, your habits and your life.
What Actually Changes After a Private Luxury Detox Retreat?
The physical changes are immediate and dramatic.

Weight comes off. Skin clears. Energy returns in a way that feels clean and real rather than the caffeinated, stimulated version you have been running on. Sleep deepens. Digestion normalises. The inflammation that has been creating pain, brain fog and physical discomfort begins to resolve.
The habits change too. Not through willpower.

Through understanding. Through the physical and emotional reset that removes the underlying need for the coping mechanisms. Clients who have been drinking heavily find the desire simply is not there anymore. Those who have been smoking or vaping discover the habit was serving an emotional need that has now been addressed another way.
The mental clarity that returns is often what clients describe most powerfully.
The fog they had normalised lifts. Decisions become clearer. Creativity returns. The version of themselves they knew they were capable of being becomes accessible again.
And they do not just leave feeling better. They leave knowing exactly how they are going to live differently and why that life will not require what the old one did.

"I'd been to doctors, specialists, you name it. Nobody had connected the dots the way the Alive team did in the first few days. The health assessment alone was worth flying across the world for. And then everything that followed built on that. I left with actual answers, an actual plan and a body that felt completely different. Genuinely grateful to every single person on that team."
Andrew, Managing Director, Sydney
Frequently Asked Questions About Private Luxury Detox Retreats
What kinds of habits and substances does the Alive detox program address?

The Alive private detox program works with clients managing alcohol use, prescription medication dependency, smoking, vaping, recreational substance use, poor diet and nutritional habits, weight issues and the accumulated toxic load of high stress high performance lifestyles. Every client is assessed individually to confirm we can genuinely help before any program begins.
How quickly do clients feel the effects of the detox program?

Most clients feel a significant shift within the first two to three days. The biomedical protocols, IV therapy and nutritional support create rapid change at a cellular level. By the end of the first week the physical transformation is typically visible and tangible in energy, sleep, skin and mental clarity.
Is weight loss part of the detox program?

Yes. Weight loss is a natural outcome for most clients. However if you do not need to lose weight the customised detox and nutrition based meals will be adjusted to suit. The combination of personalised detox nutrition, gut restoration, hormonal support, movement and the removal of the underlying drivers of weight gain creates sustainable results that continue well after leaving.
How long does a private detox retreat need to be?

Most detox clients stay between two and four weeks. The depth of the biomedical work combined with the habit, emotional and lifestyle transformation requires time to deliver results that genuinely hold. Program length is confirmed during your initial private consultation.
Is the detox retreat completely confidential?

Completely. Every element of your program, your identity and your reason for being with us is held within the strictest confidentiality. You can reach out under an alias or have a trusted representative make first contact on your behalf. From the outside you are simply on holiday in a private luxury villa in Bali or Mexico.
How do I know if the Alive detox program is right for me?

One honest conversation will tell us both. We take the time to understand your specific situation in detail before confirming we are the right fit and that we can genuinely deliver results for you. We only work with clients we are confident we can help.
Where It Begins
Your body has been carrying too much for too long. And something in you knows it is time to deal with it properly.
Not a temporary fix. Not a quick cleanse.
A real, deep, permanent reset of your body, your habits and the life that has been driving them.
Private. Luxurious. Built entirely around you.
And it begins with a single honest conversation.
